window.label: Current UTC quota day to verified clock upper bound
window.d1Bucket: datetimeHour; current hour partial/analytics ingestion lag possible
window.workersBucket: datetime filter; analytics ingestion lag/sampling may apply

mode: One authenticated GraphQL query only. No inventory request, D1 SQL, mutation, upload, deployment or user payload.

graphql.query: query ReadOnlyUtcDayPublicationUsage($accountTag: string, $start: string, $end: string) { viewer { accounts(filter: {accountTag: $accountTag}) { d1Account: d1AnalyticsAdaptiveGroups(limit: 10000, filter: {datetimeHour_geq: $start, datetimeHour_leq: $end}) {sum {readQueries writeQueries rowsRead rowsWritten} dimensions {databaseId}} workersAccount: workersInvocationsAdaptive(limit: 10000, filter: {datetime_geq: $start, datetime_leq: $end}) {sum {requests errors subrequests} dimensions {scriptName status}} } } }

userProvidedPlan.source: Human user confirmation passed through root

illustrativeQuotaBudget.note: Cap-minus-observed is an analytics-based provisional balance, not a guaranteed lower bound; ingest lag/sampling/ongoing traffic are unknown. Conservative column includes yesterday from prior rolling window and is deliberately stricter.
